content.help: Render resolution of the wrist panel. 0 = 1920x1080, 1 = 2560x1440, 2 = 3840x2160. Higher fits more but costs GPU. Re-open a panel after changing.

content.text: Wrist Icons  (pick an overlay by name)

content.help: Overlay this wrist icon opens. 'Off' hides just this icon. 'Auto' = SkyrimNet dashboard. Otherwise pick an overlay by name - the list rebuilds itself each launch as overlays are found, and your choice stays bound to that overlay by name. Re-launch after installing a new overlay mod for it to appear here.
